original:
Use case: ui-mockup / ads-marketing. Create ONE polished finished portrait social share card, aspect ratio 4:5, for RaceSide, a premium Russian motorsport app. It must be a single flat full-bleed graphic ready to share in Telegram or a feed, NOT a screenshot of a website or a modal, NOT a phone mockup, NOT a board of multiple designs.
Reference 1 is the exact RaceSide horizontal brand logo; preserve its red RS symbol and white wordmark. Reference 2 is Max Verstappen's existing app portrait in a helmet, reference 3 Kimi Antonelli's app portrait in a helmet, reference 4 Lewis Hamilton's app portrait in a helmet. Use these as identity/asset references, cut out their checkerboard backgrounds completely. Do not reinterpret the logo or change the identity of any driver. This is a NEW redesigned composition.

Creative direction: an elegant race result sheet with an expressive winner portrait and disciplined sports editorial typography. Obsidian #090909 background, white #f5f4f2 text, secondary text clearly readable #b8b8b8, one restrained RaceSide red #e10600 accent. Geist Sans-like modern type and Geist Mono-like tabular timing numbers. Mixed-case Russian headings and names, small uppercase only for short metadata. Flat sections separated by subtle hairline rules, no stacked rounded cards, no glass, no metallic podium blocks, no gold medals, no car image, no glow or broad gradients. Large readable text, impeccable alignment and generous 48px-equivalent margins. All text is genuine Russian and must be sharp and accurately spelled.

Composition and exact content, top to bottom:
1. Compact top row: logo from reference 1 at left, "СЕЗОН 2026 / ЭТАП 16" at right.
2. Race title, two-line or one-line confident heading: "Гран-при Малайзии". Smaller subtitle: "Сепанг / 4 октября / 55 кругов". Small red text "Итоги за минуту".
3. Main winner area: bold large "P1", name "Макс Ферстаппен", "Red Bull", race time "1:47:14.808" and "25 очков". Max's helmet portrait cutout on the right occupies roughly one quarter of the card width; it feels substantial but does not overwhelm the data. Avoid a giant decorative podium. Winner remains the visual focus.
4. Two compact runners-up side by side on one shared row, with small circular portraits from references 3 and 4, a tiny turquoise/red team-color dot, name, gap and points:
"P2  Кими Антонелли" / "Mercedes" / "+2.307 / 18 очков"
"P3  Льюис Хэмилтон" / "Ferrari" / "+4.919 / 15 очков".
5. One flat horizontal band of three useful facts, with big numbers and small readable labels:
"Лучший круг" / "1:38.220" / "Ферстаппен"
"Больше всего позиций" / "+12" / "Линдблад"
"На финише" / "19 из 22" / "3 схода".
6. "Очковая десятка". A compact clean table in two columns of five rows, with consistent column headings "Пилот", "Отрыв", "Очки", no portraits here, tiny team-color marks permitted. Use the following EXACT rows:
left column:
"1  Ферстаппен" / "—" / "25"
"2  Антонелли" / "+2.307" / "18"
"3  Хэмилтон" / "+4.919" / "15"
"4  Леклер" / "+7.258" / "12"
"5  Хаджар" / "+8.571" / "10"
right column:
"6  Пиастри" / "+9.454" / "8"
"7  Лоусон" / "+12.753" / "6"
"8  Алонсо" / "+13.372" / "4"
"9  Норрис" / "+13.993" / "2"
"10  Линдблад" / "+15.928" / "1".
Each driver, gap and points is visible once within the table. Align decimal timing numbers. Make the table legible in a phone feed.
7. One restrained strip "Чемпионат после этапа" with the top three in separate columns, emphasizing points:
"1  Антонелли" / "320 очков"
"2  Расселл" / "236 очков"
"3  Хэмилтон" / "214 очков".
8. Brief editorial context, only two lines, heading "Вокруг этапа"; text "После гонки обсуждали решение FIA вернуть исходный стартовый порядок." This is a news summary, not a verdict about what decided the race.
9. Compact red footer band: "Полный отчёт на RaceSide" at left, "raceside.online" at right. No QR code, no UI buttons, no source metadata, no unavailable-data placeholders.

Priority: visual hierarchy, correct content and readable text. The graphic should feel useful enough to save, refined enough to share, and consistent with RaceSide. Fit every specified section neatly within the portrait card, no clipped text, no invented facts or extra blocks. High-resolution finished design.
refinement: Refine the existing RaceSide social card. Make ONE layout correction in the upper hero only: the entire heading «Гран-при Малайзии» must be fully readable with no portrait overlap or hidden letters. Keep it at the same large readable size and position across the top. Reduce Max Verstappen's cutout portrait by about 30–35%, place it on the right of the winner area BELOW the complete race title/subtitle, with its top around the winner name and its bottom above the P2/P3 row. Keep his face/helmet identity intact and give the winner portrait sufficient breathing room. The winner text, P1, time, points and every lower section must remain in their existing order. Preserve the entire table, stats, standings, context paragraph, RaceSide logo, palette, footer and exact numbers. No new text or blocks. Preserve portrait 4:5 format. Output the complete finished card, not a crop.
